title: The Xiaomi 18 Pro proves two screens aren’t better than one
description: Both 18 Pro phones feature rear displays used for selfies, notifications, and AI apps. Xiaomi introduced a second screen to its flagship phones with last year

content.summary: Both 18 Pro phones feature rear displays used for selfies, notifications, and AI apps. Xiaomi introduced a second screen to its flagship phones with last year's 17 Pros, but didn't release them outside China. That means the new 18 Pro and Pro Max are the first chance I've had to find out if a screen on the back of a phone is any more useful now than it was when Xiaomi last tried it on 2021's Mi 11 Ultra - not to mention earlier efforts by the likes of Nubia and Vivo. After a week or two with both of Xiaomi's new Pro phones, I'm not entirely sold. The rear display has a single, obvious use case - it's helped me take some of the best selfies I've ever managed - but it isn't very useful otherwise.
